To this day, the tech community has yet to establish a standard definition for "world models." However, this has not stopped it from becoming the most compelling narrative of the moment: in the eyes of VCs, it is the ultimate sandbox for validating business closed loops; in the field of embodied intelligence, it serves as the predictive brain that enables robots to "think three steps ahead"; and amidst the ruins of the metaverse, it is seen as the final piece of the puzzle for transitioning information carriers from 2D videos to 3D interactive worlds. items.title: 创新Transformer！面壁基于稀疏-线性混合架构SALA训练9B模型，端侧跑通百万上下文
items.raw_excerpt: 众所周知，Transformer 及其核心的全注意力机制（Full Attention）虽长期占据大模型架构的核心地位，但平方级计算复杂度、高额显存占用的瓶颈，早已成为实现超长上下文处理与模型规模化应用的 “拦路虎”。敢于挑战这一固有权威，需要的不仅是实现 AGI 长远目标勇于创新的魄力，更需要有独到的技术视野以及突破技术壁垒的硬实力。从 DeepSeek 的稀疏注意力（DSA）、MiniMax 的线性注意力、到月之暗面的线性注意力（KDA），大家纷纷投入注意力架构的革新竞技场。 今天，面壁智能也在这场变革中迈出了关键一步：正式发布行业首个大规模训练的稀疏-线性注意力混合架构 SALA（Sparse Attention-Linear Attention，简称SALA），以及基于该架构的文本模型 MiniCPM-SALA，以追求更长文本处理能力与极致的推理性价比。MiniCPM-SALA 不仅在多项长文本理解与生成评测中优势明显，且在知识问答、数学推理、代码生成等核心能力维度上，保持了与同规模全注意力模型相当的卓越水平，实现了“长短兼备”的综合性能表现，以及极致推理性价比。 ▍MiniCPM-SALA 亮点一览  ▪ 架构革新：“稀疏-线性”注意力混合架构，在显著降低推理开销与显存占用的同时，克服了纯线性架构在长程信息召回上的精度瓶颈，效率性能兼顾。 ▪ 卓越性能：采用HyPE（混合位置编码）来有效协调短上下文和长上下文的性能。在保持通用能力（如知识、数学和编码）与其他8B全注意力模型相当的同时，MiniCPM-SALA 在多个长上下文基准测试中表现出明显优势。 ▪ 高效推理：不使用投机采样等加速算法，在云端推理芯片上，当序列长度为256K词元时推理速度高达 Qwen3-8B 的 3.5 倍，并支持在云端芯片和消费级端侧 GPU 上进行

excerpt_i18n.en: As is well known, although the Transformer and its core full attention mechanism have long dominated the architecture of large models, the bottlenecks of quadratic computational complexity and high memory consumption have long been obstacles to achieving ultra-long context processing and scalable model applications. Challenging this established authority requires not only the innovative courage to pursue the long-term goal of AGI but also unique technical vision and the hard capabilities to break through technical barriers. From DeepSeek's sparse attention (DSA) and MiniMax's linear attention to Moonshot AI's linear attention (KDA), many have entered the competitive arena of attention architecture innovation. Today, ModelBest has taken a crucial step in this transformation: officially releasing the industry's first large-scale trained sparse-linear attention hybrid architecture, SALA (Sparse Attention-Linear Attention), along with the text model MiniCPM-SALA based on this architecture, aiming for longer text processing capabilities and extreme reasoning cost-effectiveness. MiniCPM-SALA not only demonstrates clear advantages in multiple evaluations of long-text understanding and generation but also maintains excellent performance comparable to full-attention models of the same scale in core capabilities such as knowledge question answering, mathematical reasoning, and code generation, achieving comprehensive performance that excels in both short and long contexts, along with extreme reasoning cost-effectiveness. ▍MiniC
excerpt_i18n.es: Es bien sabido que, aunque el Transformer y su mecanismo central de atención completa han ocupado durante mucho tiempo una posición central en la arquitectura de los grandes modelos, el cuello de botella de la complejidad computacional cuadrática y el alto consumo de memoria de video se ha convertido en un obstáculo para el procesamiento de contextos ultralargos y la aplicación escalable de modelos. Desafiar esta autoridad inherente requiere no solo el coraje innovador para perseguir el objetivo a largo plazo de la AGI, sino también una visión técnica única y la capacidad sólida para superar las barreras tecnológicas. Desde la atención dispersa de DeepSeek y la atención lineal de MiniMax, hasta la atención lineal de Dark Side of the Moon.
